option_relations.rationale: Atrioventricular Nodal Reentrant Tachycardia (AVNRT) is a specific type of Paroxysmal Supraventricular Tachycardia (PSVT), making the option a direct example of the leaf.
Focal Junctional Tachycardia is a distinct arrhythmia from Atrioventricular Nodal Reentrant Tachycardia.
Sinus Tachycardia with Isorhythmic Atrioventricular Dissociation is a distinct arrhythmia from Atrioventricular Nodal Reentrant Tachycardia.
Accelerated atrioventricular junctional tachycardia with isorhythmic atrioventricular dissociation is a distinct arrhythmia from Atrioventricular Nodal Reentrant Tachycardia.
